dog.description_text: Milo is a 30-pound gentle giant with a heart just as big as his belly! This sweet, slightly shy boy came to us as an owner surrender and is still warming up to his new surroundings. He may need a little time to come out of his shell, but underneath all that fluff is a whole lot of love! Looking for a little extra cat to love? Milo is your guy!
